dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Huh? Looking for me at this hour of the day... This falls outside of my predictions.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ahem... Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Of course! The conditions and facilities are first-class, and it's very comfortable here.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: So comfortable that... I'm a bit worried that it might be hard to adjust once I leave.

choices.text: Then... shouldn't you leave before it's too late?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Wh—What? No! Are you serious?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Why you...! Hmph... since you're letting me stay here for free, I'll let that pass...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Hmm... Let me think of a way to repay you somehow.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: This way, we won't be indebted to each other.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: R—Really?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Being able to live in such a wonderful place without having to pay rent... Am I dreaming?

choices.text: There goes the Great Astrologist's pride...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Alright, I'm in good spirits. Is there anything you wish to know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to hear some of your knowledge!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh... how studious of you.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I am indisputably an erudite scholar, for my learning encompasses the stars above and earth below.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ...But it would consume a considerable amount of time to explain the tenets of astrology...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: For now, some practical advice will do!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Hmm... For instance, ingredients approaching their expiration date can be used to create very cost-effective meals as long as you thoroughly cook them with the appropriate cooking methods.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Many stores have monthly sales. Find an opportune time to stock up on grains and dried foods. As staple foods, they will keep you feeling full for a long time.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Also... Processing your own meat products is much cheaper than buying them ready-made.

choices.text: Your knowledge is all about saving money...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Ah...! Huh!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: How impolite of you to generalize it as such!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: These techniques are all a crucial element of living a disciplined life. They are the result of refinement of the objective laws of the world.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: S—So I'll be stricter with you. You need to be more disciplined if you are to understand this world's truths!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Heh, you will understand how useful these are once you try.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: After you have mastered these, I will impart more of the secret wonders hidden deep within this world.

choices.text: You seem to have a lot of life experience...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Well, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmm, I want to reserve some of your spare time. Let's go on a vacation together.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A... A vacation?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Maybe on an uninhabited island or in a quiet rainforest, just somewhere we can put work aside and relax for a bit.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Is that so...? Hey, you don't just think of me as some research-obsessed maniac with a one-track mind, do you?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Everything I do is to comprehend the truths of the world... Even a vacation is a way to meet this end.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I started preparing for this a long time ago.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Saving money can be difficult, so I specially prepared a savings jar. Every time I received a payment, I put aside some of it.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: During this time, I also resisted buying hardcover copies of research manuscripts... Eventually, I had saved up enough.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Hehe, it's alright, it was worth it!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Okay! I'll await your word.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Huh? What do you mean by that?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Thanks for being considerate, but this is something I want to do, so it really is fine.

choices.text: Then I'll go set aside some time.
Do you have funds for this...?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Hehe, I've already prepared them, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Mona.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh, good morning.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: If you need anything, I'll make time for you. Call me if there is something you can't resolve.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Mona.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: It's already time for you to turn in? If you ask me, there's never enough time in a day.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}. Yes, go replenish your strength.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ...Quite the dignified study. May I use it as well?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: In that case, I hope you don't mind if I stack all the star maps I bought over here.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmm... I still have those things I bought on sale. If I want to maximize my use of space, I'll need to plan this out more carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Let me quickly inspect the ingredients in the kitchen...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: After all, you will most certainly need wisdom to turn limited ingredients into a dish that can keep you full for an entire day.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Oh yes, thank you for preparing these! If you're not averse, you're welcome to try some as well.
